Thanks for the follow-up. Both sides are lower-cased now, and I kept the fallback: exact host matches win, and only when none exist does it fall back to domains whose host contains the requested one, so robots.txt on the bare host still resolves a www-only sales channel. Since the TLD behaviour is unchanged, I didn't add a release note. I also added unit tests for the port/case handling and for the fallback. I stuck with the string normalisation rather than `$request->getHost()` to keep the X-Forwarded-Host change out of this PR.
